units.title: 点单
units.can: 能在店里点单，并回答店员的追问。

sound.title: 词重音
sound.note_zh: 多音节词里有一个音节读得更响、更长、更高，其余音节轻而短。重音放错，对方可能听不出你说的是哪个词。先记住单词的重音位置，再把它放进句子里。

pattern.note_zh: 点东西、提要求时最自然的说法，比 I want 客气。I'd 读成一个音节 /aɪd/，后面直接跟名词；please 放句尾，语气更软。

sentences.en: I'd like a coffee, please.
I'd like a table for two, please.
I'd like the chicken, please.
I'd like some water, please.
I'd like to try this one, please.
I'd like a window seat, please.

swaps.en: I'd like two tickets, please.
I'd like a room for tonight, please.
I'd like a small one, please.

task.scene_zh: 你在咖啡店柜台点单。要一杯饮料和一样吃的，店员会追问大小和堂食还是外带。
task.role: You are a barista at a busy coffee shop. Take the customer's order. Ask about the size and whether it is for here or to go.
task.opener: Hi there! What can I get for you today?
task.goal_zh: 用 I'd like ... 点一杯饮料和一样吃的，并回答大小、堂食还是外带两个问题。

units.title: 能不能
units.can: 能客气地问对方能不能做一件事。

sound.title: 句重音
sound.note_zh: 一句话里，名词、动词、形容词这些实词要加重；冠词、介词、be 动词一带而过。别每个词一样重，把重的词托起来，对方才抓得住重点。

pattern.note_zh: Can I ...? 用来客气地问能不能做某事，后面直接跟动词原形。句尾升调，等对方回答。

sentences.en: Can I sit here?
Can I have a coffee, please?
Can I pay by card?
Can I see the menu?
Can I borrow your phone?
Can I come in a little late?

swaps.en: Can I have some water?
Can I use your pen?

swaps.cue_zh: 我能换到里面那张桌子吗？
swaps.en: Can I move to that table inside?

task.scene_zh: 你在餐厅门口，想问清能不能给你一张桌子、能不能坐窗边、能不能刷卡。服务员会回答并反问你几位。
task.role: You are the host at a small restaurant. Answer the customer's questions and ask how many people are in their party.
task.opener: Good evening! Welcome. How many in your party?
task.goal_zh: 用 Can I ...? 问清三件事：能不能给你一张桌子、能不能坐窗边、能不能刷卡。

units.title: 说计划
units.can: 能说出自己的计划，并回答时间和方式的问题。

sound.title: 弱读
sound.note_zh: to、a、the、can、and 这些小词在句子里要读得又快又轻：to 像 /tə/，a 像 /ə/，can 像 /kən/。别把小词一个个读清楚，轻下来，句子才有英语的节奏。

items.text: I'm going to call her tonight.
items.mark: I'm GO-ing tə CALL ər tə-NIGHT.

pattern.note_zh: 说打算做的事，用 be going to + 动词原形，比 will 更像已经想好了。口语里 going to 常读得快而轻。

sentences.en: I'm going to call her tonight.
I'm going to take the train.
We're going to move next month.
I'm going to cook at home.
He's going to start a new job.
I'm going to work from home tomorrow.

swaps.en: I'm going to see a doctor.
We're going to stay two nights.
She's going to study tonight.

task.scene_zh: 朋友问你周末有什么安排。你说要做的事，朋友会追问什么时候、怎么去、和谁一起。
task.role: You are the learner's friend. Ask about weekend plans, then follow up with questions about when, how, and who with.
task.opener: Hey! Any plans for the weekend?
task.goal_zh: 用 I'm going to ... 说出周末要做的一件事，并回答时间、怎么去两个追问。

units.title: 问有没有
units.can: 能问对方有没有某样东西。

sound.title: 连读
sound.note_zh: 前一个词以辅音结尾、后一个词以元音开头时，把那个辅音滑到后面去，听起来像连成一个词。比如 take it 像 ta-kit，turn it on 像 tur-ni-ton。

pattern.note_zh: 问对方有没有某样东西，用 Do you have ...? 后面直接跟名词。有就说 Yes, I do，没有就说 Sorry, I don't。

sentences.en: Do you have a minute?
Do you have any water?
Do you have this in medium?
Do you have a phone charger?
Do you have time on Friday?
Do you have a map of the city?

swaps.en: Do you have a table for four?
Do you have any milk?
Do you have change for ten dollars?

task.scene_zh: 你在药店，一直咳嗽，想买止咳药。药剂师会问症状，你可以问有没有别的选择、怎么吃。
task.role: You are a pharmacist. Ask about the customer's symptoms, then answer questions about what you have and how to take it.
task.opener: Hi, how can I help you today?
task.goal_zh: 用 Do you have ...? 问出至少两种药，并问清一天吃几次。

units.title: 说我需要
units.can: 能说出自己必须做的事，并问清条件。

sound.title: 断句
sound.note_zh: 长句子别一口气冲完，按意思切成几小组，每组一口气，组间停一小下。停错地方会把两个不该连的词连到一起，对方就要猜。

items.text: I need to go home and charge my phone.
items.mark: I NEED to GO HOME / and CHARGE my PHONE.

items.text: I need to call my boss before six.
items.mark: I NEED to CALL my BOSS / before SIX.

pattern.note_zh: 说必须做的事，用 I need to + 动词原形，比 must 口语，意思和 have to 差不多。否定是 I don't need to。

sentences.cue_zh: 我六点前得给老板打个电话。
sentences.en: I need to call my boss before six.
I need to buy some milk.
We need to leave early.
I need to see a doctor.
You need to sign here.
I need to charge my phone.

swaps.en: I need to finish this today.
I need to pick up my kids.
I need to pay the rent.

task.scene_zh: 你在看一套出租房。房东问你觉得怎么样、什么时候能搬，你要问清房租含不含水电，并说搬进来之前要做的事。
task.role: You are the landlord showing a small apartment. Answer the learner's questions about rent and utilities, ask when they want to move in, and ask if there is anything they need to do before moving in.
task.opener: Hi! Come on in. So, what do you think of the place?
task.goal_zh: 用 I need to ... 说出至少两件搬进来之前要做的事，并问清房租含不含水电。

units.title: 问要多久
units.can: 能问清做一件事要多久。

sound.title: 语调
sound.note_zh: 陈述句句尾往下掉，听着像说完了；yes/no 问句句尾往上挑，等着对方回答；what、how 开头的特殊问句句尾往下掉。同一句话，调子不同，意思就不一样。↗ 表示升调，↘ 表示降调。

items.text: How long does it take to get there?
items.mark: how LONG does it TAKE to get THERE? ↘

pattern.frame: How long does it take to ...?
pattern.note_zh: 问做一件事要多久，用 How long does it take to + 动词原形? 回答用 It takes + 时间。

sentences.en: How long does it take to get there?
How long does it take to cook this?
How long does it take to learn it?
How long does it take to walk there?
How long does it take to get a visa?
How long does it take to get there by bus?

swaps.en: How long does it take to fix it?
How long does it take to get a reply?
How long does it take to walk from here?

task.scene_zh: 你在车站问去机场的大巴。工作人员会告诉你班次，你想知道路上多久、多久一班、在哪儿买票。
task.role: You are a worker at the bus station. Answer questions about the airport bus: travel time, how often it runs, and where to buy tickets.
task.opener: Hi, can I help you find something?
task.goal_zh: 用 How long does it take to ...? 问清到机场要多久，并问出多久一班、在哪儿买票。

units.title: 平时和今天
units.can: 能对比平时和今天的做法，并说明原因。

sound.title: /iː/ 和 /ɪ/
sound.note_zh: /iː/ 嘴角往两边拉开，声音长一点，像 sheep、seat；/ɪ/ 嘴放松，短而轻，像 ship、sit。ship 说成 sheep、sit 说成 seat，对方会听成另一个词。

items.text: I usually eat at home, but today I'm eating out.
items.mark: I U-su-al-ly EAT at HOME, but to-DAY I'm EAT-ing OUT.

pattern.note_zh: 对比平时的习惯和今天的情况：前面用一般现在时说习惯，后面用 today I'm + 动词-ing 说今天正在做或已经定了的事。

sentences.cue_zh: 我平时在家吃，今天在外面吃。
sentences.en: I usually eat at home, but today I'm eating out.

sentences.cue_zh: 我平时坐公交，今天走路。
sentences.en: I usually take the bus, but today I'm walking.
I usually work late, but today I'm leaving early.

sentences.cue_zh: 我平时喝茶，今天喝咖啡。
sentences.en: I usually drink tea, but today I'm drinking coffee.

sentences.cue_zh: 我平时做饭，今天点披萨。
sentences.en: I usually cook, but today I'm ordering pizza.

sentences.cue_zh: 我平时给她发短信，今天打电话。
sentences.en: I usually text her, but today I'm calling her.

swaps.cue_zh: 我平时开车，今天坐火车。
swaps.en: I usually drive, but today I'm taking the train.

swaps.cue_zh: 我平时起得早，今天睡懒觉。
swaps.en: I usually get up early, but today I'm sleeping in.

swaps.cue_zh: 我平时待在家，今天出门。
swaps.en: I usually stay home, but today I'm going out.

task.scene_zh: 同事看到你今天没在工位吃午饭，问你怎么了。你说平时怎样、今天怎样，还要解释原因。
task.role: You are the learner's coworker. Notice that they are not eating at their desk today, as they usually do. Ask what is different today and why.
task.opener: Hey, you're not eating at your desk today. What's up?
task.goal_zh: 用 I usually ..., but today I'm ... 说出一组平时和今天的对比，并给出原因。

units.title: 请人帮忙
units.can: 能客气地请别人重复、放慢或帮忙。

sound.title: /æ/ 和 /e/
sound.note_zh: /æ/ 嘴张大，下巴放下来，像 bad、cat；/e/ 嘴张得小一点，像 bed、pen。bad 说成 bed，对方会以为你在说床。

items.text: Could you hand me that bag?
items.mark: Could you HAND me that BAG?

pattern.note_zh: Could you ...? 比 Can you ...? 更客气，后面跟动词原形。请人帮忙、重复、放慢时最常用。

sentences.en: Could you say that again?
Could you help me with this?
Could you speak a little slower?
Could you open the window?
Could you send me the address?
Could you hand me that bag?

swaps.en: Could you close the door?
Could you call me back?
Could you show me how?

task.scene_zh: 线上会议声音不清楚，你请旁边的同事重复一遍、说慢一点，并借一副耳机。同事会回答并问你听清没有。
task.role: You are the learner's coworker in the office. Respond to requests for help with the online meeting and lend headphones.
task.goal_zh: 用 Could you ...? 请同事重复一遍、说慢一点，并借到一副耳机。

units.title: 说看法
units.can: 能说出自己的看法，并给出理由。

sound.title: /θ/ 和 /s/
sound.note_zh: /θ/ 舌尖轻轻放在上下牙之间，气从缝里出来，像 think、thank；/s/ 舌尖在嘴里，不碰牙，像 sink、sank。think 说成 sink，意思就变了。

items.text: I think we should wait, because it's raining.
items.mark: I THINK we should WAIT, be-CAUSE it's RAIN-ing.

pattern.note_zh: 说看法用 I think 加一句话，给理由用 because 加一句话。because 后面要跟完整的主谓。

sentences.cue_zh: 我觉得该等一等，因为在下雨。
sentences.en: I think we should wait, because it's raining.

sentences.cue_zh: 我觉得他说得对，因为他懂规则。
sentences.en: I think he's right, because he knows the rules.

sentences.cue_zh: 我觉得太贵了，因为要五十块。
sentences.en: I think it's too expensive, because it costs fifty dollars.

sentences.cue_zh: 我觉得她累了，因为她上了一天班。
sentences.en: I think she's tired, because she worked all day.

sentences.cue_zh: 我觉得这个更好，因为小一点。
sentences.en: I think this one is better, because it's smaller.

sentences.cue_zh: 我觉得我们迷路了，因为我看不到路牌。
sentences.en: I think we're lost, because I can't see any signs.

swaps.cue_zh: 我觉得这主意不错，因为省时间。
swaps.en: I think it's a good idea, because it saves time.

swaps.cue_zh: 我觉得他需要帮忙，因为看着像迷路了。
swaps.en: I think he needs help, because he looks lost.

swaps.cue_zh: 我觉得该走了，因为不早了。
swaps.en: I think we should go now, because it's late.

task.scene_zh: 朋友想现在出门，你看了看天气和路程，觉得该等一等。朋友问你的意见，你要说看法和理由。
task.role: You are the learner's friend. Suggest going out now, then ask for their opinion and reason.
task.opener: So, should we go now or wait a bit?
task.goal_zh: 用 I think ..., because ... 说出现在该不该出门，并给出至少一个理由。

units.title: 说以前
units.can: 能对比以前和现在的习惯。

sound.title: 词尾辅音
sound.note_zh: 词尾的辅音要轻轻收住，不能整个丢掉，也不能在后面加一个元音，比如 want 不要读成 "wan-te"。方括号里是要收住的尾音。

items.text: I used to run, but now I walk.
items.mark: I USED to RU[n], but NOW I WAL[k].

pattern.frame: I used to ..., but now I ...
pattern.note_zh: 说以前的习惯用 used to + 动词原形，现在不这样了用 but now 加一般现在时。used to 的 d 几乎不发音。

sentences.en: I used to run, but now I walk.

sentences.cue_zh: 我以前抽烟，现在不抽了。
sentences.en: I used to smoke, but now I don't.

sentences.cue_zh: 我以前住市中心，现在住这儿。
sentences.en: I used to live downtown, but now I live here.

sentences.cue_zh: 我们以前常在外面吃，现在自己做。
sentences.en: We used to eat out, but now we cook.

sentences.cue_zh: 她以前上夜班，现在上白班。
sentences.en: She used to work nights, but now she works days.

sentences.cue_zh: 我以前讨厌咖啡，现在很爱喝。
sentences.en: I used to hate coffee, but now I love it.

swaps.cue_zh: 我以前打网球，现在游泳。
swaps.en: I used to play tennis, but now I swim.

swaps.cue_zh: 他以前是老师，现在卖车。
swaps.en: He used to be a teacher, but now he sells cars.

swaps.cue_zh: 我以前坐公交，现在骑车。
swaps.en: I used to take the bus, but now I bike.

task.scene_zh: 多年没见的老朋友问你现在过得怎么样。他问你还做不做以前的运动、还住不住原来的地方，你说以前怎样、现在怎样。
task.role: You are the learner's old friend. Ask what has changed in their life since you last met.
task.opener: Wow, it's been years! So what's new with you?
task.goal_zh: 用 I used to ..., but now I ... 说出一组以前和现在的变化，并回答朋友的一个追问。
